subject: english
question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

The teacher who had conducted the workshop earlier, (1)/ along with his assistants, (2) / have submitted the final report to the board (3) / before the deadline last week. (4)

options.text: have submitted the final report to the board (3)
The teacher who had conducted the workshop earlier (1)

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The subject of the sentence is "**The teacher**," which is singular.
 
• The verb "**have**" is incorrect as it is used for plural subjects. The correct verb should be "**has**" to match the singular subject.
 
• Thus, the error lies in **Option 2**, where "**have**" should be replaced with "<stron
